eligibility_contract.redistribution: source terms and row provenance are preserved; non-curated BindingDB imports require source-specific distribution review
eligibility_contract.scientific_training_eligible: valid current-policy parent structure, single reported protein chain, accession or sequence, positive parseable endpoint-specific nM label, supported relation, and strong mirror screen
eligibility_contract.sequence_model_eligible: scientific eligibility plus reported or unambiguously resolved sequence

endpoint_contract.binding_free_energy_reason: Delta-G derivation requires an explicit thermodynamic endpoint, standard state, and temperature; IC50, Ki, and EC50 are not silently converted

identity_contract.homology_boundary: exact accession/sequence leakage is blocked now; sequence-similarity cluster splits remain a later HPC preprocessing step
identity_contract.scaffold: Bemis-Murcko; acyclic structures and rare RDKit scaffold-extraction failures use the exact standardized parent as a conservative no-leak fallback
identity_contract.target_leakage_group: connected component over exact accession tokens and exact sequence SHA-256 tokens
identity_contract.target_record: reported accession set plus exact reported sequence hash
identity_contract.unambiguous_sequence_resolution: an accession-only record receives a sequence only when its connected component has exactly one reported sequence

label_contract.interval_censored: both bounds retained; no midpoint imputation

mirror_contract.strong_cross_source_key: current-policy parent structure + exact accession-or-sequence token + endpoint + relation/bounds + normalized DOI/PMID/patent
mirror_contract.unknown_document_replicates: retained because experimental identity is not established

split_contract.double_cold: eligible only when independently assigned ligand-scaffold and target-component partitions agree; mixed assignments are explicitly null
